name: Antispam by CleanTalk
description: Antispam service from CleanTalk to protect your site
project_description:
Provides complex, powerful, and invisible spam protection without CAPTCHA/reCaptcha. Blocks spam comments, bots, and protects all forms on your website – no CAPTCHAs, puzzles, or delays.

 Anti spam module info. 
 Spam attacks log 

Spam logs are stored for 7 or 45 days, ensuring accurate filtering and easy verification.

 Real-Time Email Address Existence Validation 

It is important for website owners to prevent misspelled email addresses because it ensures notifications are delivered, improves customer experience, and protects your customers from email misspellings.

 Private blocklists 

Personal Blocklists by IP and email addresses allow the site owner to block unwanted users or spammers, protecting the site from repeated attacks.

 Blocking comments by "stop words" 

Block comments containing specific "stop words" or obscene phrases to enhance spam protection and maintain content quality. You can easily add custom words or phrases to your personal blocklist.

 Block by Country 

Automatically block comments and registrations from specific countries. Ideal if your website targets a local audience or faces country-specific spam attacks.

 Spam FireWall 

Spam FireWall instantly blocks known spambots before they even reach your site, dramatically reducing server load and keeping your pages fast. Spam FireWall checks visitors’ IPs against a regularly updated list spam active IPs and networks, real users see your website as usual, while bots receive a block page. You can also customize firewall protection with personal IP lists, enhancing your defense against spam and DoS attacks.

 Anti-Crawler: Bot Protection & Management 

Anti-Crawler provides robust bot protection and comprehensive bot management, automatically blocking unwanted bots after their second visit. Easily control known crawlers, like SEO or scanning bots, by allowing or denying access based on your preferences—keeping your site secure and performing efficiently.

 CleanTalk Anti-Spam helps website owners solve problems like spam comments, registrations, block bots, prevent email input errors. Helps improve your site security, ensures smooth communication with your audience and maintains high-quality user experience, saving your valuable time and resources.

 CleanTalk as reCAPTCHA alternative .
